Compendium.Name: Technomancy Expansion
Compendium.Description: An expansion compendium introducing advanced tech attributes, hacking skills, and cyber-damage types.

Abilities.Name: Processing
Abilities.Description: Character's computational speed and logical multitasking ability

Abilities.Name: Resonance
Abilities.Description: Character's attunement to digital and cybernetic frequencies

Skills.Name: Hacking
Skills.Description: Bypassing digital firewalls and manipulating mainframe security systems.

Skills.Name: Overclocking
Skills.Description: Pushing cybernetic hardware beyond safe thermal limits for short-term power spikes.

Skills.Name: Cyber-Athletics
Skills.Description: Using reinforced servo-actuators to enhance physical lifting and jumping beyond biological limits.

DamageTypes.Name: EMP
DamageTypes.Description: Electromagnetic pulse damage that fries circuits and deactivates cyberware.

DamageTypes.Name: Plasma
DamageTypes.Description: Superheated ionized gas that melts armor and burns flesh simultaneously.
